quotes.quote: Of course it is happening inside your head, Harry, but why on earth should that mean that it is not real?
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: A kiss is a lovely trick designed by nature to stop speech when words become superfluous.
quotes.author: Ingrid Bergman

quotes.quote: The art of healing comes from nature, not from the physician. Therefore the physician must start from nature, with an open mind.
quotes.author: Paracelsus

quotes.quote: Every artist dips his brush in his own soul, and paints his own nature into his pictures.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Art in Nature is rhythmic and has a horror of constraint.
quotes.author: Robert Delaunay

quotes.quote: The mission of art is to represent nature not to imitate her.
quotes.author: William Morris Hunt

quotes.quote: In the long term we can hope that religion will change the nature of man and reduce conflict. But history is not encouraging in this respect. The bloodiest wars in history have been religious wars.
quotes.author: Richard M. Nixon

quotes.quote: This is part of the involuntary bargain we make with the world just by being alive. We get to experiences the splendor of nature, the beauty of art, the balm of love and the sheer joy of existence, always with the knowledge that illness, injury, natural disaster, or pure evil can end it in an instant for ourselves or someone we love.
quotes.author: Jeff Greenfield

quotes.quote: Nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: It's our nature: Human beings like success but they hate successful people.
quotes.author: Carrot Top

quotes.quote: Art and nature shall always be wrestling until they eventually conquer one another so that the victory is the same stroke and line: that which is conquered, conquers at the same time.
quotes.author: Maria Sibylla Merian

quotes.quote: Art, as far as it is able, follows nature, as a pupil imitates his master; thus your art must be, as it were, God's grandchild.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: Art is the child of Nature; yes, her darling child, in whom we trace the features of the mother's face, her aspect and her attitude.
quotes.author: Beck

quotes.quote: To so enter into it in nature and art that the enjoyed meanings of life may become a part of living is the attitude of aesthetic appreciation.
quotes.author: George Herbert Mead

quotes.quote: Even in modern art, artists have used methods based on calculation, inasmuch as these elements, alongside those of a more personal and emotional nature, give balance and harmony to any work of art.
quotes.author: Max Bill

quotes.quote: The elusive nature of love... it can be such a fleeting thing. You see it there and it's just fluttering and it's gone.
quotes.author: Mick Jagger

quotes.quote: A secondhand wardrobe hand clothes doesn't make one an artist. Neither do a hair-trigger temper, melancholic nature, propensity for tears, hating your parents, or HIV. I hate to say it - none of these make one an artist. They can help, but just as being gay doesn't make one witty... the only thing that makes one an artist is making art.
quotes.author: David Rakoff

quotes.quote: For instance, on the planet Earth, man had always assumed that he was more intelligent than dolphins because he had achieved so much--the wheel, New York, wars and so on--whilst all the dolphins had ever done was muck about in the water having a good time. But conversely, the dolphins had always believed that they were far more intelligent than man--for precisely the same reasons.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: There's design, and there's art. Good design is total harmony. There's no better designer than nature - if you look at a branch or a leaf, it's perfect. It's all function. Art is different. It's about emotion. It's about suffering and beauty - but mostly suffering!
quotes.author: Diane von Furstenberg

quotes.quote: All things are artificial, for nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Thomas Browne

quotes.quote: Nature is inside art as its content, not outside as its model.
quotes.author: Marilyn French

quotes.quote: I have seen many storms in my life. Most storms have caught me by surprise, so I had to learn very quickly to look further and understand that I am not capable of controlling the weather, to exercise the art of patience and to respect the fury of nature.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: A beautiful lady is an accident of nature. A beautiful old lady is a work of art.
quotes.author: Louis Nizer

quotes.quote: Art is nature speeded up and God slowed down.
quotes.author: Malcolm de Chazal

quotes.quote: It will, of course, be understood that directly or indirectly, soon or late, every advance in the sciences of human nature will contribute to our success in controlling human nature and changing it to the advantage of the common weal.
quotes.author: Edward Thorndike

quotes.quote: Art will never be able to exist without nature.
quotes.author: Pierre Bonnard

quotes.quote: Life is a disease: sexually transmitted, and invariably fatal.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman

quotes.quote: Were I called on to define, very briefly, the term Art, I should call it 'the reproduction of what the Senses perceive in Nature through the veil of the soul.' The mere imitation, however accurate, of what is in Nature, entitles no man to the sacred name of 'Artist.'
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: Painting is by nature a luminous language.
quotes.author: Robert Delaunay

quotes.quote: Art is the right hand of Nature. The latter has only given us being, the former has made us men.
quotes.author: Friedrich Schiller

quotes.quote: No better way is there to learn to love Nature than to understand Art. It dignifies every flower of the field. And, the boy who sees the thing of beauty which a bird on the wing becomes when transferred to wood or canvas will probably not throw the customary stone.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: 'Healing,' Papa would tell me, 'is not a science, but the intuitive art of wooing nature.'
quotes.author: W. H. Auden

quotes.quote: Weeds are flowers, too, once you get to know them.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: Philosophically considered, the universe is composed of Nature and the Soul. Strictly speaking, therefore, all that is separate from us, all which Philosophy distinguishes as the 'Not Me,' that is, both nature and art, all other men and my own body, must be ranked under this name, 'Nature.'
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Pain and suffering are always inevitable for a large intelligence and a deep heart. The really great men must, I think, have great sadness on earth.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

quotes.quote: Death must be so beautiful. To lie in the soft brown earth, with the grasses waving above one's head, and listen to silence. To have no yesterday, and no tomorrow. To forget time, to forgive life, to be at peace.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Canterville Ghost

quotes.quote: Land really is the best art.
quotes.author: Andy Warhol

quotes.quote: Book collecting is an obsession, an occupation, a disease, an addiction, a fascination, an absurdity, a fate. It is not a hobby. Those who do it must do it.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson

quotes.quote: Usually I'm remarkably good natured. Try me on a day that doesn't end in y.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare

quotes.quote: My life amounts to no more than one drop in a limitless ocean. Yet what is any ocean, but a multitude of drops?
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: My favorite place in Indonesia is Bali. I was there with my family in Nusa Dua, and my kids loved it. I'm a workaholic, so for me, Bali is a place where you can have a vacation, but you can have your own moment as well. You feel like you blend with nature - and I love the beach.
quotes.author: Joe Taslim

quotes.quote: With freedom, books, flowers, and the moon, who could not be happy?
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: It's a lot easier to be lost than found. It's the reason we're always searching and rarely discovered--so many locks not enough keys.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Lock and Key

quotes.quote: The right of nature... is the liberty each man hath to use his own power, as he will himself, for the preservation of his own nature; that is to say, of his own life.
quotes.author: Thomas Hobbes

quotes.quote: Little white lies are part of everyday life. If you're in court being charged with a felony, you're probably going to be tempted to lie. Or if your girlfriend asks you if the sweater she is wearing makes her look fat; you're going to lie because you love that person. There are different reasons and justifications to lie; it's human nature.
quotes.author: Monica Raymund

quotes.quote: He's a wallflower. You see things. You keep quiet about them. And you understand.
quotes.author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

quotes.quote: All art is but imitation of nature.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: To cherish what remains of the Earth and to foster its renewal is our only legitimate hope of survival.
quotes.author: Wendell Berry

quotes.quote: I am aloof by nature. I mind my own business. I'm good with everyone, and I get along fine with people. But work is work, and friendship is friendship. I never mix the two.
quotes.author: Sonakshi Sinha

quotes.quote: Live in the sunshine, swim the sea, drink the wild air.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Three Rings for the Elven-kings under the sky, Seven for the Dwarf-lords in halls of stone,Nine for Mortal Men, doomed to die, One for the Dark Lord on his dark throneIn the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie. One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them, One Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them.In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Lord of the Rings

quotes.quote: There is pleasure in the pathless woods, there is rapture in the lonely shore, there is society where none intrudes, by the deep sea, and music in its roar; I love not Man the less, but Nature more.
quotes.author: Lord Byron

quotes.quote: It wouldn't be my move,"Jace agreed. "First the candy and flowers, then the apology letters, then the ravenous demon hordes. In that order.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: But it is the nature of stars to cross, and never was Shakespeare more wrong than when he has Cassius note, 'The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars / But in ourselves.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: And so with the sunshine and the great bursts of leaves growing on the trees, just as things grow in fast movies, I had that familiar conviction that life was beginning over again with the summer.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  The Great Gatsby

quotes.quote: I've found that there is always some beauty left -- in nature, sunshine, freedom, in yourself; these can all help you.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

quotes.quote: Love is a canvas furnished by nature and embroidered by imagination.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: There is more to sex appeal than just measurements. I don't need a bedroom to prove my womanliness. I can convey just as much sex appeal, picking apples off a tree or standing in the rain.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: What if it lines up like it did in the Trojan War ... Athena versus Poseidon?""I don't know. But I just know that I'll be fighting next to you.""Why?""Because you're my friend, Seaweed Brain. Any more stupid questions?
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

quotes.quote: For whatever we lose (like a you or a me),It's always our self we find in the sea.
quotes.author: E.E. Cummings,  100 Selected Poems

quotes.quote: She says nothing at all, but simply stares upward into the dark sky and watches, with sad eyes, the slow dance of the infinite stars.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  Stardust

quotes.quote: I am a cage, in search of a bird.
quotes.author: Franz Kafka

quotes.quote: I felt my lungs inflate with the onrush of scenery--air, mountains, trees, people. I thought, "This is what it is to be happy.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

quotes.quote: Let me give you a piece of advice. The handsome young fellow who's trying to rescue you from a hideous fate is never wrong. Not even if he says the sky is purple and made of hedgehogs.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness, and many of our people need it sorely on these accounts. Broad, wholesome, charitable views of men and things cannot be acquired by vegetating in one little corner of the earth all one's lifetime.
quotes.author: Mark Twain,  The Innocents Abroad/Roughing It

quotes.quote: Out of suffering have emerged the strongest souls; the most massive characters are seared with scars.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran

quotes.quote: Hello babies. Welcome to Earth. It's hot in the summer and cold in the winter. It's round and wet and crowded. On the outside, babies, you've got a hundred years here. There's only one rule that I know of, babies-"God damn it, you've got to be kind.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: The earth has music for those who listen.
quotes.author: George Santayana

quotes.quote: My course is set for an uncharted sea.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: Sex is part of nature. I go along with nature.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: The ships hung in the sky in much the same way that bricks don't.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: My bounty is as boundless as the sea,My love as deep; the more I give to thee,The more I have, for both are infinite.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

quotes.quote: Nothing on earth can make up for the loss of one who has loved you.
quotes.author: Selma LagerlÃ¶f

quotes.quote: Boring damned people. All over the earth. Propagating more boring damned people. What a horror show. The earth swarmed with them.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: If you don't know history, then you don't know anything. You are a leaf that doesn't know it is part of a tree.
quotes.author: Michael Crichton

quotes.quote: If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.
quotes.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  The Secret Garden

quotes.quote: You believe in a book that has talking animals, wizards, witches, demons, sticks turning into snakes, burning bushes, food falling from the sky, people walking on water, and all sorts of magical, absurd and primitive stories, and you say that we are the ones that need help?
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: But I love your feet only because they walked upon the earth and upon the wind and upon the waters, until they found me.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: The clearest way into the Universe is through a forest wilderness.
quotes.author: John Muir

quotes.quote: It is very risky. But each time a child opens a book, he pushes open the gate that separates him from Elsewhere.
quotes.author: Lois Lowry

quotes.quote: What is straight? A line can be straight, or a street, but the human heart, oh, no, it's curved like a road through mountains.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams,  A Streetcar Named Desire

quotes.quote: I wonder if the snow loves the trees and fields, that it kisses them so gently? And then it covers them up snug, you know, with a white quilt; and perhaps it says "Go to sleep, darlings, till the summer comes again.
quotes.author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice's Adventures in Wonderland & Through the Looking-Glass

quotes.quote: Dreams come true. Without that possibility, nature would not incite us to have them.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: Love is like a tree: it grows by itself, roots itself deeply in our being and continues to flourish over a heart in ruin. The inexplicable fact is that the blinder it is, the more tenacious it is. It is never stronger than when it is completely unreasonable.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  The Hunchback of Notre-Dame

quotes.quote: In times of grief and sorrow I will hold you and rock you and take your grief and make it my own. When you cry I cry and when you hurt I hurt. And together we will try to hold back the floods to tears and despair and make it through the potholed street of life
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

quotes.quote: What are men to rocks and mountains?
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

quotes.quote: Look at everything always as though you were seeing it either for the first or last time: Thus is your time on earth filled with glory.
quotes.author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

quotes.quote: In the summerI stretch out on the shoreAnd think of you. Had I told the seaWhat I felt for you,It would have left its shores,Its shells,Its fish,And followed me.
quotes.author: Nizar Qabbani

quotes.quote: He stepped back and threw his arms out."I'm always crazy around you Rose. Here, I'm going to write an impromptu poem for you."He tipped his head back and shouted to the sky:"Rose is in redBut never in blueSharp as a thornFights like one too.
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Shadow Kiss

quotes.quote: I know of a cure for everything: salt water...in one way or the other. Sweat, or tears, or the salt sea.
quotes.author: Karen Blixen

quotes.quote: Laugh all you want and cry all you want and whistle at pretty men in the street and to hell with anybody who thinks you're a damned fool!
quotes.author: Armistead Maupin,  More Tales of the City

quotes.quote: The voice of the sea speaks to the soul.
quotes.author: Kate Chopin,  The Awakening

quotes.quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
quotes.author: Benjamin Britten

quotes.quote: Is there some particular reason that you're here?"..."Not this again.""Not what again?"said Clary."Every time I annoy him, he retreats into his No Mundanes Allowed tree house."Simon pointed at Jace.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: Raise your words, not voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: Heaven knows we need never be ashamed of our tears, for they are rain upon the blinding dust of earth, overlying our hard hearts. I was better after I had cried, than before--more sorry, more aware of my own ingratitude, more gentle.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens,  Great Expectations

quotes.quote: Are you, are you coming to the tree? Wear a necklace of rope, side by side with me. Strange things did happen here. No stranger would let it be if we met up At midnight in the hanging tree.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: There are worlds of experience beyond the world of the aggressive man, beyond history, and beyond science. The moods and qualities of nature and the revelations of great art are equally difficult to define; we can grasp them only in the depths of our perceptive spirit.
quotes.author: Ansel Adams

quotes.quote: 'Hill Street,' because of the wacky nature of many of our characters, really allowed us to indulge a kind of cheek-to-jowl juxtaposition of high drama with very low humor.
quotes.author: Steven Bochco

quotes.quote: The sunlight claps the earth, and the moonbeams kiss the sea: what are all these kissings worth, if thou kiss not me?
quotes.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quotes.quote: Simplicity is natures first step, and the last of art.
quotes.author: Philip James Bailey

quotes.quote: Tiger got to hunt, bird got to fly;Man got to sit and wonder 'why, why, why?'Tiger got to sleep, bird got to land;Man got to tell himself he understand.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Cat's Cradle

quotes.quote: Youth is the gift of nature, but age is a work of art.
quotes.author: Stanislaw Jerzy Lec

quotes.quote: I like this place and could willingly waste my time in it.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: Rain is grace; rain is the sky descending to the earth; without rain, there would be no life.
quotes.author: John Updike

quotes.quote: There is a pleasure in the pathless woods,There is a rapture on the lonely shore,There is society, where none intrudes,By the deep sea, and music in its roar:I love not man the less, but Nature more
quotes.author: George Gordon Byron

quotes.quote: In youth, it was a way I had,To do my best to please.And change, with every passing ladTo suit his theories.But now I know the things I knowAnd do the things I do,And if you do not like me so,To hell, my love, with you.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker,  The Complete Poems of Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: My art is an attempt to reach beyond the surface appearance. I want to see growth in wood, time in stone, nature in a city, and I do not mean its parks but a deeper understanding that a city is nature too-the ground upon which it is built, the stone with which it is made.
quotes.author: Andy Goldsworthy

quotes.quote: Life itself is offensive and certainly does not apologize - in fact, it hurts considerably and, as we all know, is often very rude and troublesome, just as nature or art can be.
quotes.author: Michael Leunig

quotes.quote: Those who contemplate the beauty of the earth find reserves of strength that will endure as long as life lasts. There is something infinitely healing in the repeated refrains of nature -- the assurance that dawn comes after night, and spring after winter.
quotes.author: Rachel Carson,  Silent Spring

quotes.quote: The art of medicine consists in amusing the patient while nature cures the disease.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: A quiet secluded life in the country, with the possibility of being useful to people to whom it is easy to do good, and who are not accustomed to have it done to them; then work which one hopes may be of some use; then rest, nature, books, music, love for one's neighbor -- such is my idea of happiness.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Family Happiness

quotes.quote: He was mastered by the sheer surging of life, the tidal wave of being, the perfect joy of each separate muscle, joint, and sinew in that it was everything that was not death, that it was aglow and rampant, expressing itself in movement, flying exultantly under the stars.
quotes.author: Jack London,  The Call of the Wild

quotes.quote: Many artists and scholars have pointed out that ultimately art depends on human nature.
quotes.author: Steven Pinker

quotes.quote: In the end, nature is inexorable: it has no reason to hurry and, sooner or later, it takes what belongs to it. Unconsciously and inflexibly obedient to its own laws, it doesn't know art, just as it doesn't know freedom, just as it doesn't know goodness.
quotes.author: Ivan Turgenev

quotes.quote: Our most intimate friend is not he to whom we show the worst, but the best of our nature.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: I can't begin to tell you how fulfilling the perennial nature of 'Elf' on television has been for me. It's great to be able to connect parents with children both emotionally and through humor.
quotes.author: Jon Favreau

quotes.quote: I do not deny that I have made drawings and watercolors of an erotic nature. But they are always works of art. Are there no artists who have done erotic pictures?
quotes.author: Egon Schiele

quotes.quote: I mean, we are tribal by nature, and sometimes success and material wealth can divide and separate - it's not a new philosophy I'm sharing - more than hardship, hardship tends to unify.
quotes.author: Colin Farrell

quotes.quote: It is a law woven into the nature of man, attested by history, by science, by literature and art, and by dally experience, that strength of mind and force of character are the supreme rulers of human affairs.
quotes.author: Lucius Quintus Cincinnatus Lamar II

quotes.quote: Dear God! how beauty varies in nature and art. In a woman the flesh must be like marble; in a statue the marble must be like flesh.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: ...and then, I have nature and art and poetry, and if that is not enough, what is enough?
quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh

quotes.quote: It is good to realize that if love and peace can prevail on earth, and if we can teach our children to honor nature's gifts, the joys and beauties of the outdoors will be here forever.
quotes.author: Jimmy Carter

quotes.quote: I'm naturally an optimist, but my basis for hope is rooted in my understanding of human nature.
quotes.author: Al Gore

quotes.quote: We know that God is everywhere; but certainly we feel His presence most when His works are on the grandest scale spread before us; and it is in the unclouded night-sky, where His worlds wheel their silent course, that we read clearest His infinitude, His omnipotence, His omnipresence.
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: There's a snobbery at work in architecture. The subject is too often treated as a fine art, delicately wrapped in mumbo-jumbo. In reality, it's an all-embracing discipline taking in science, art, maths, engineering, climate, nature, politics, economics.
quotes.author: Norman Foster

quotes.quote: This life is yours. Take the power to choose what you want to do and do it well. Take the power to love what you want in life and love it honestly. Take the power to walk in the forest and be a part of nature. Take the power to control your own life. No one else can do it for you. Take the power to make your life happy.
quotes.author: Susan Polis Schutz

quotes.quote: I was an anorexic, beer drinking, class cutting, doodling, shoplifting, skater chick that was into nature, art class, and the beach.
quotes.author: Rebecca Miller

quotes.quote: The poetry of the earth is never dead.
quotes.author: John Keats

quotes.quote: I have lived pain, and my life can tell: I only deepen the wound of the world when I neglect to give thanks the heavy perfume of wild roses in early July and the song of crickets on summer humid nights and the rivers that run and the stars that rise and the rain that falls and all the good things that a good God gives.
quotes.author: Ann Voskamp

quotes.quote: An appeaser is one who feeds a crocodile, hoping it will eat him last.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: If I were a tree, I would have no reason to love a human.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  The Raven Boys

quotes.quote: The creation of a thousand forests is in one acorn
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: The tree which moves some to tears of joy is in the eyes of others only a green thing that stands in the way. Some see nature all ridicule and deformity... and some scarce see nature at all. But to the eyes of the man of imagination, nature is imagination itself.
quotes.author: William Blake

quotes.quote: Plant seeds of happiness, hope, success, and love; it will all come back to you in abundance. This is the law of nature.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Art is a harmony parallel with nature.
quotes.author: Paul Cezanne

quotes.quote: Even with all our technology and the inventions that make modern life so much easier than it once was, it takes just one big natural disaster to wipe all that away and remind us that, here on Earth, we're still at the mercy of nature.
quotes.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

quotes.quote: When you do something noble and beautiful and nobody noticed, do not be sad. For the sun every morning is a beautiful spectacle and yet most of the audience still sleeps.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Religion. A daughter of Hope and Fear, explaining to Ignorance the nature of the Unknowable.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce

quotes.quote: Controversy is part of the nature of art and creativity.
quotes.author: Yoko Ono

quotes.quote: Our love went from fly to flower to butterfly, and it was meant to beautifully flutter, not sit still on a shelf like a trophy to be collected.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: As in nature, as in art, so in grace; it is rough treatment that gives souls, as well as stones, their luster.
quotes.author: Thomas Guthrie

quotes.quote: I believe in God, only I spell it Nature.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright,  Truth Against the World: Frank Lloyd Wright Speaks for an Organic Architecture

quotes.quote: My hands will get dirty holding your rose-shaped heart, because love is like gardening--it's earthy and takes work to keep it alive.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If the stars should appear one night in a thousand years, how would men believe and adore; and preserve for many generations the remembrance of the city of God which had been shown! But every night come out these envoys of beauty, and light the universe with their admonishing smile.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Nature and Selected Essays

quotes.quote: I'd like to get away from earth awhileAnd then come back to it and begin over.May no fate wilfully misunderstand meAnd half grant what I wish and snatch me awayNot to return. Earth's the right place for love:I don't know where it's likely to go better.
quotes.author: Robert Frost,  Birches

quotes.quote: The goal of life is to make your heartbeat match the beat of the universe, to match your nature with Nature.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell,  A Joseph Campbell Companion: Reflections on the Art of Living

quotes.quote: I do not think that there is any other quality so essential to success of any kind as the quality of perseverance. It overcomes almost everything, even nature.
quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller

quotes.quote: Looking at beauty in the world, is the first step of purifying the mind.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

quotes.quote: Love the trees until their leaves fall off, then encourage them to try again next year.
quotes.author: Chad Sugg

quotes.quote: Professional wrestling is a lot like cuddling, I thought as I hugged a tree. As far as lumberjacks go, I'm slow, but when the tree finally falls for me, it falls hard.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: If we surrenderedto earth's intelligencewe could rise up rooted, like trees.

quotes.quote: I think trees should bloom earlier in the spring. They act like they are on a schedule. It's not like they have anywhere to go.

quotes.quote: Trees shaped like deer should not be ridden like benches if they get stuck up in other trees. No hunting farming allowed. Fishing only.

quotes.quote: Using my nipples as bait, I went fishing for compliments. I got a few bites, but nothing to write about in Field & Stream.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: And this, our life, exempt from public haunt, finds tongues in trees, books in the running brooks, sermons in stones, and good in everything.

quotes.quote: Art is contemplation. It is the pleasure of the mind which searches into nature and which there divines the spirit of which nature herself is animated.
quotes.author: Auguste Rodin

quotes.quote: I too am not a bit tamed, I too am untranslatable, I sound my barbaric yawp over the roofs of the world.

quotes.quote: Nothing is art if it does not come from nature.
quotes.author: Antoni Gaudi

quotes.quote: Man is solid, not liquid. But with the fluid nature of networking, my personal brand would grow faster if I would just go with the flow.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Sit down before fact as a little child, be prepared to give up every preconceived notion, follow humbly wherever and to whatever abysses nature leads, or you shall learn nothing. I have only begun to learn content and peace of mind since I have resolved at all risks to do this.

quotes.quote: Everyone is a salesman, and the product is each person. Personal branding is being conscious to the continual nature of selling yourself.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Nature is pleased with simplicity. And nature is no dummy
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.quote: In what terms should we think of these beings, nonhuman yet possessing so very many human-like characteristics? How should we treat them? Surely we should treat them with the same consideration and kindness as we show to other humans; and as we recognize human rights, so too should we recognize the rights of the great apes? Yes.
quotes.author: Jane Goodall

quotes.quote: I was something that lay under the sun and felt it, like the pumpkins, and I did not want to be anything more. I was entirely happy. Perhaps we feel like that when we die and become a part of something entire, whether it is sun and air, or goodness and knowledge. At any rate, that is happiness; to be dissolved into something complete and great. When it comes to one, it comes as naturally as sleep.
quotes.author: Willa Cather,  My Ãntonia

quotes.quote: Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees on a summer's day, listening to the murmur of the water, or watching the clouds float across the sky, is by no means a waste of time.
quotes.author: John Lubbock,  The Use Of Life

quotes.quote: Another glorious Sierra day in which one seems to be dissolved and absorbed and sent pulsing onward we know not where. Life seems neither long nor short, and we take no more heed to save time or make haste than do the trees and stars. This is true freedom, a good practical sort of immortality.
quotes.author: John Muir,  My First Summer in the Sierra

quotes.quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden

quotes.quote: And if these mountains had eyes, they would wake to find two strangers in their fences, standing in admiration as a breathing red pours its tinge upon earth's shore. These mountains, which have seen untold sunrises, long to thunder praise but stand reverent, silent so that man's weak praise should be given God's attention.
quotes.author: Donald Miller,  Through Painted Deserts: Light, God, and Beauty on the Open Road

quotes.quote: Just what future the Designer of the universe has provided for the souls of men I do not know, I cannot prove. But I find that the whole order of Nature confirms my confidence that, if it is not like our noblest hopes and dreams, it will transcend them.
quotes.author: Henry Norris Russell

quotes.quote: Even the ocean waves take their hellos to the people all the time. I should take my hellos down to the beach and sell waves to the tourists.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I Go Down To The ShoreI go down to the shore in the morningand depending on the hour the wavesare rolling in or moving out,and I say, oh, I am miserable,what shall--what should I do? And the sea saysin its lovely voice:Excuse me, I have work to do.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver,  A Thousand Mornings

quotes.quote: HereI'm here-the snow falling.
quotes.author: Kobayashi Issa

quotes.quote: We have no right to express an opinion until we know all of the answers.
quotes.author: Kurt Cobain

quotes.quote: I wish the night would end,I wish the day'd begin,I wish it would rain or snow,or the wind would blow,or the grass would grow,I wish I had yesterday,I wish there were games to play...
quotes.author: V.C. Andrews,  Flowers in the Attic

quotes.quote: To find the universal elements enough; to find the air and the water exhilarating; to be refreshed by a morning walk or an evening saunter... to be thrilled by the stars at night; to be elated over a bird's nest or a wildflower in spring -- these are some of the rewards of the simple life.
quotes.author: John Burroughs,  Leaf and Tendril

quotes.quote: Look! A trickle of water running through some dirt! I'd say our afternoon just got booked solid!
quotes.author: Bill Watterson

quotes.quote: The artist produces for the liberation of his soul. It is his nature to create as it is the nature of water to run down the hill.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: Great art picks up where nature ends.
quotes.author: Marc Chagall

quotes.quote: To become vegetarian is to step into the stream which leads to nirvana.
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.quote: We owe a huge debt to Galileo for emancipating us all from the stupid belief in an Earth-centered or man-centered (let alone God-centered) system. He quite literally taught us our place and allowed us to go on to make extraordinary advances in knowledge.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens

quotes.quote: When mice run, cats give chase.
quotes.author: Rachel Vincent,  Stray

quotes.quote: It's the idea that people living close to nature tend to be noble. It's seeing all those sunsets that does it. You can't watch a sunset and then go off and set fire to your neighbor's tepee. Living close to nature is wonderful for your mental health.
quotes.author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

quotes.quote: I bequeath myself to the dirt to grow from the grass I loveIf you want me again look for me under your boot-soles.You will hardly know who I am or what I meanBut I shall be good health to you nonethelessAnd filter and fibre your blood.
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.quote: These people have learned not from books, but in the fields, in the wood, on the river bank. Their teachers have been the birds themselves, when they sang to them, the sun when it left a glow of crimson behind it at setting, the very trees, and wild herbs.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: The secret to modeling is not being perfect. What one needs is a face that people can identify in a second. You have to be given what's needed by nature, and what's needed is to bring something new.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Man is the most insane species. He worships an invisible God and destroys a visible Nature. Unaware that this Nature he's destroying is this God he's worshiping.
quotes.author: Hubert Reeves

quotes.quote: Calligraphy of geeseagainst the sky-the moon seals it.
quotes.author: Yosa Buson

quotes.quote: Science cannot solve the ultimate mystery of nature. And that is because, in the last analysis, we ourselves are a part of the mystery that we are trying to solve.
quotes.author: Max Planck,  Where is Science Going?

quotes.quote: Hope is nature's veil for hiding truth's nakedness.
quotes.author: Alfred Nobel

quotes.quote: There is no God, Nature sufficeth unto herself; in no wise hath she need of an author.
quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: Caelum non animum mutant qui trans mare currunt.(They change their sky, not their soul, who rush across the sea.)
quotes.author: Horace,  The Odes of Horace: Bilingual Edition

quotes.quote: I remember discussions with Bohr which went through many hours till very late at night and ended almost in despair; and when at the end of the discussion I went alone for a walk in the neighbouring park I repeated to myself again and again the question: Can nature possibly be so absurd as it seemed to us in these atomic experiments?
quotes.author: Werner Heisenberg

quotes.quote: The happiest man is he who learns from nature the lesson of worship
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Nature

quotes.quote: Earth is sad, Moon is shy, Sun is happy but wait a moment, I just forgot to tell you that I am the child of open sky.
quotes.author: Santosh Kalwar

quotes.quote: Every flower is a soul blossoming in nature.
quotes.author: GÃ©rard de Nerval

quotes.quote: I didn't need to understand the hypostatic unity of the Trinity; I just needed to turn my life over to whoever came up with redwood trees.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott,  Plan B: Further Thoughts on Faith

quotes.quote: The fact that a cloud from a minor volcanic eruption in Iceland--a small disturbance in the complex mechanism of life on the Earth--can bring to a standstill the aerial traffic over an entire continent is a reminder of how, with all its power to transform nature, humankind remains just another species on the planet Earth.

quotes.quote: The best remedy for those who are afraid, lonely or unhappy is to go outside, somewhere where they can be quite alone with the heavens, nature and God.
quotes.author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

quotes.quote: I perceive God everywhere in His works. I sense Him in me; I see Him all around me.
quotes.author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quotes.quote: The real purpose of the scientific method is to make sure nature hasn't misled you into thinking you know something you actually don't know.
quotes.author: Robert M. Pirsig,  Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance: An Inquiry Into Values

quotes.quote: Nothing is too wonderful to be true if it be consistent with the laws of nature.
quotes.author: Michael Faraday

quotes.quote: Mother Nature doesn't care if you're having fun.
quotes.author: Larry Niven

quotes.quote: I love coffee cake, but I would prefer if it were just a little more drinkable. I almost choked while chugging some this morning, and if it weren't for the fluid nature of clownfish, I might have caught feelings for Hillary using a basketball net.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: We shall never achieve harmony with the land, anymore than we shall achieve absolute justice or liberty for people. In these higher aspirations the important thing is not to achieve but to strive.
quotes.author: Aldo Leopold,  Round River: From the Journals of Aldo Leopold

quotes.quote: A withered maple leaf has left its branch and is falling to the ground; its movements resemble those of a butterfly in flight. Isn't it strange? The saddest and deadest of things is yet so like the gayest and most vital of creatures?

quotes.quote: Religion, n. A daughter of Hope and Fear, explaining to Ignorance the nature of the Unknowable.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce,  The Unabridged Devil's Dictionary

quotes.quote: For I have learned to look on nature, not as in the hour of thoughtless youth; but hearing oftentimes the still, sad music of humanity.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth,  Lines Composed a Few Miles Above Tintern Abbey

quotes.quote: The longing for Paradise is man's longing not to be man.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: I want to find a way of speaking to fellow human beings that will be cool rather than heated, philosophical rather than polemical, that will bring enlightenment rather than seeking to divide us into the righteous and the sinners, the saved and the damned, the sheep and the goats.
quotes.author: J.M. Coetzee,  The Lives of Animals

quotes.quote: By Hays' reasoning, penetrating a rectum with a penis is a violation of how God meant humans to function. Apparently human bodies were designed to be penetrated by metal implements, but not by flesh.
quotes.author: Hector Avalos

quotes.quote: When asked if I am pessimistic or optimistic about the future, my answer is always the same: if you look at the science about what is happening on earth and aren't pessimistic, you don't understand the data. quotes.quote: It's very, very dangerous to lose contact with living nature.
quotes.author: Albert Hofmann

quotes.quote: The recipe for great art has always been misery and a good bowel movement.
quotes.author: Don Roff

quotes.quote: I don't ask for the meaning of the song of a bird or the rising of the sun on a misty morning. There they are, and they are beautiful.
quotes.author: Pete Hamill

quotes.quote: To only responsible choice I can make is to be love and happiness."Vincellent"Love the world as you love yourself".Lao Tze"The next step in mans evolution will be the survival of the wisest.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Nature and Nature's laws lay hid in night:God said, Let Newton be! and all was light.
quotes.author: Alexander Pope

quotes.quote: Our love was bornoutside the walls,in the wind,in the night,in the earth,and that's why the clay and the flower,the mud and the rootsknow your name.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: What would the world be, once bereft Of wet and of wildness? Let them be left, O let them be left, wildness and wet; Long live the weeds and the wilderness yet.
quotes.author: Gerard Manley Hopkins,  Gerard Manley Hopkins: The Complete Poems

quotes.quote: The winds, the sea, and the moving tides are what they are. If there is wonder and beauty and majesty in them, science will discover these qualities... If there is poetry in my book about the sea, it is not because I deliberately put it there, but because no one could write truthfully about the sea and leave out the poetry.
quotes.author: Rachel Carson

quotes.quote: But in my opinion, all things in nature occur mathematically.
quotes.author: RenÃ© Descartes

quotes.quote: What a marvelous cooperative arrangement - plants and animals each inhaling each other's exhalations, a kind of planet-wide mutual mouth-to-stoma resuscitation, the entire elegant cycle powered by a star 150 million kilometers away.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

quotes.quote: What you are, and who you are should provide greater clarity about where you have been and where you are headed. Although one distinguishes spiritual from physical nature, the ultimate unification of the two is the consequence of the struggle for internal, external and eternal - peace.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: I go to books and to nature as the bee goes to a flower, for a nectar that I can make into my own honey.
quotes.author: John Burroughs,  The Summit of the Years

quotes.quote: He who hears the rippling of rivers in these degenerate days will not utterly despair.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Scientific principles and laws do not lie on the surface of nature. They are hidden, and must be wrested from nature by an active and elaborate technique of inquiry.
quotes.author: John Dewey,  Reconstruction in Philosophy

quotes.quote: Why did you look at the sunset?'Philip answered with his mouth full:Because I was happy.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Of Human Bondage

quotes.quote: The fish is my friend too...I have never seen or heard of such a fish. But I must kill him. I am glad we do not have to try to kill the stars. Imagine if each day a man must try to kill the moon, he thought. The moon runs away. But imagine if a man each day should have to try to kill the sun? We were born lucky; he thought
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Old Man and the Sea

quotes.quote: Man masters nature not by force, but by understanding
quotes.author: Jacob Bronowski

quotes.quote: Why are there trees I never walk under but large and melodious thoughts descend upon me?
quotes.author: Walt Whitman

quotes.quote: Green in nature is one thing, green in literature another. Nature and letters seem to have a natural antipathy; bring them together and they tear each other to pieces.
quotes.author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

quotes.quote: Inebriate of Air -- am I --And Debauchee of Dew --Reeling -- thro endless summer days --From Inns of Molten Blue --
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson,  Selected Poems

quotes.quote: Fireflies in the GardenBy Robert Frost 1874-1963 Here come real stars to fill the upper skies, And here on earth come emulating flies, That though they never equal stars in size, (And they were never really stars at heart) Achieve at times a very star-like start. Only, of course, they can't sustain the part.
quotes.author: Robert Frost,  The Poetry of Robert Frost

quotes.quote: Always it's Spring)and everyone's in love and flowers pick themselves.
quotes.author: E.E. Cummings,  100 Selected Poems

quotes.quote: The first law of nature is self-preservation. Cut off that which may harm you. But if it is worth preserving, and is meaningful, nourish it and have no regrets. Ultimately, this is true living and love of self...from within.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Dans la nature rien ne se crÃ©e, rien ne se perd, tout change.In nature nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything changes.
quotes.author: Antoine Lavoisier,  TraitÃ© Ã©lÃ©mentaire de chimie

quotes.quote: We are here because one odd group of fishes had a peculiar fin anatomy that could transform into legs for terrestrial creatures; because the earth never froze entirely during an ice age; because a small and tenuous species, arising in Africa a quarter of a million years ago, has managed, so far, to survive by hook and by crook. We may yearn for a 'higher answer'- but none exists
quotes.author: Stephen Jay Gould

quotes.quote: Love is that splendid triggering of human vitality the supreme activity which nature affords anyone for going out of himself toward someone else.
quotes.author: Jose Ortega y Gasset

quotes.quote: The use of sea and air is common to all; neither can a title to the ocean belong to any people or private persons, forasmuch as neither nature nor public use and custom permit any possession therof.
quotes.author: Queen Elizabeth I,  Letters

quotes.quote: In your hands winteris a book with cloud pagesthat snow pearls of love.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: â€ŽUsing his burgeoning intelligence, this most successful of all mammals has exploited the environment to produce food for an ever increasing population. Instead of controlling the environment for the benefit of the population, perhaps it's time we controlled the population to allow the survival of the environment.
quotes.author: David Attenborough

quotes.quote: The stars are forth, the moon above the topsOf the snow-shining mountains.--Beautiful!I linger yet with Nature, for the nightHath been to me a more familiar faceThan that of man; and in her starry shadeOf dim and solitary loveliness,I learn'd the language of another world.
quotes.author: George Gordon Byron,  Manfred: A Dramatic Poem

quotes.quote: If the ignorance of nature gave birth to such a variety of gods, the knowledge of this nature is calculated to destroy them.
quotes.author: Paul Henri Thiry d'Holbach,  System of Nature

quotes.quote: An experiment is a question which science poses to Nature and a measurement is the recording of Nature's answer.
quotes.author: Max Planck,  Scientific Autobiography and Other Papers

quotes.quote: If you could really see that tree over there,"Merlin said, "you would be so astounded that you'd fall over.""Really? But why?"asked Arthur. "It's just a tree.""No,"Merlin said, "It's just a tree in your mind. To another mind it is an expression of infinite spirit and beauty. In God's mind it is a dear child, sweeter than anything you can imagine.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra,  The Way of the Wizard: Twenty Spiritual Lessons for Creating the Life You Want

quotes.quote: I found the poems in the fields,And only wrote them down.
quotes.author: John Clare,  The Later Poems, 1837-1864: Volumes I and II

quotes.quote: We ought not to ask why the human mind troubles to fathom the secrets of the universe. The diversity of the phenomena of nature is so great, and the treasures hidden in the skies so rich, precisely in order that the human mind shall never be lacking in fresh nourishment.
quotes.author: Johannes Kepler

quotes.quote: There is no such things as magic, though there is such a thing as knowledge of the hidden ways of Nature.
quotes.author: H. Rider Haggard,  She

quotes.quote: Laws of nature have no physical properties of mass /energy. They are platonic truths in transcendent realm that create & govern the Universe.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Whether in the intellectual pursuits of science or in the mystical pursuits of the spirit, the light beckons ahead, and the purpose surging in our nature responds.
quotes.author: Arthur Stanley Eddington,  The Nature of the Physical World

quotes.quote: I believe it is in my nature to dance by virtue of the beat of my heart, the pulse of my blood and the music in my mind.
quotes.author: Robert Fulghum

quotes.quote: There are souls, he thought, whose umbilicus has never been cut. They never got weaned from the universe. They do not understand death as an enemy; they look forward to rotting and turning into humus.
quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin,  The Dispossessed

quotes.quote: Our Father who art in nature, who has given the gift of survival to the coyote, the common brown rat, the English sparrow, the house fly and the moth, must have a great and overwhelming love for no-goods and blots-on-the-town and bums, and Mack and the boys. Virtues and graces and laziness and zest. Our Father who art in nature.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck,  Cannery Row

quotes.quote: [On Schopenhauer in Black and White] Schopenhauer's views of love are flawed. Love can't be merely an illusion of the mind to aid in procreation, but the path to redemption for an otherwise violently selfish species. Past human greatness has proven that when challenged, love can overpower impulsive instinct, and in essence, the vilest aspects of our nature.
quotes.author: Tiffany Madison

quotes.quote: Every blade in the field - Every leaf in the forest - lays down its life in its season as beautifully as it was taken up.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Everything is political. I will never be a politician or even think political. Me just deal with life and nature. That is the greatest thing to me.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: A true conservationist is a man who knows that the world is not given by his fathers, but borrowed from his children.
quotes.author: John James Audubon

quotes.quote: I don't believe that math and nature respond to democracy. Just because very clever people have rejected the role of the infinite, their collective opinions, however weighty, won't persuade mother nature to alter her ways. Nature is never wrong.
quotes.author: Janna Levin,  How the Universe Got Its Spots: Diary of a Finite Time in a Finite Space

quotes.quote: I am a member of a fragile species, still new to the earth, the youngest creatures of any scale, here only a few moments as evolutionary time is measured, a juvenile species, a child of a species. We are only tentatively set in place, error prone, at risk of fumbling, in real danger at the moment of leaving behind only a thin layer of of our fossils, radioactive at that.
quotes.author: Lewis Thomas,  Fragile Species

quotes.quote: There is no unmoving mover behind the movement. It is only movement. It is not correct to say that life is moving, but life is movement itself. Life and movement are not two different things. In other words, there is no thinker behind the thought. Thought itself is the thinker. If you remove the thought, there is no thinker to be found.
quotes.author: Walpola Rahula,  What the Buddha Taught: Revised and Expanded Edition with Texts from Suttas and Dhammapada

quotes.quote: How was she created? I'm not sure if you realize this, but it was in God's image. How can anybody dare to speak ill of something which bears such a noble imprint?
quotes.author: Christine de Pizan,  The Book of the City of Ladies

quotes.quote: Could two live that way? Could two live under the wild rose, and explore by the pond, so that the smooth mind of each is as everywhere present to the other, and as received and as unchallenged, as falling snow?
quotes.author: Annie Dillard,  Teaching a Stone to Talk: Expeditions and Encounters

quotes.quote: I am of old and young, of the foolish as much as the wise,Regardless of others, ever regardful of others,Maternal as well as paternal, a child as well as a man,Stuffed with the stuff that is course, and stuffed with the stuff that is fine, one of the nation, of many nations, the smallest the same and the the largest
quotes.author: Walt Whitman,  Song of Myself

quotes.quote: What comes, when it comes, will be what it is.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Collected Poems of Alberto Caeiro

quotes.quote: One had to live a long time to know a man's true nature.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez,  Love in the Time of Cholera

quotes.quote: When you enter a grove peopled with ancient trees, higher than the ordinary, and shutting out the sky with their thickly inter-twined branches, do not the stately shadows of the wood, the stillness of the place, and the awful gloom of this doomed cavern then strike you with the presence of a deity?
quotes.author: Luci Anneu SÃ¨neca

quotes.quote: Science, like art, is not a copy of nature but a re-creation of her.
quotes.author: Jacob Bronowski,  Science & Human Values

quotes.quote: I don't have a philosophy: I have senses...If I talk about Nature, it's not because I know what it is,But because I love it, and that's why I love it,Because when you love you never know what you love,Or why you love, or what love is.Loving is eternal innocence,And the only innocence is not thinking.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Keeper of Sheep

quotes.quote: Nature, to be commanded, must be obeyed. The imagination must be given not wings but weights.
quotes.author: Henry Adams,  The Education of Henry Adams

quotes.quote: And looks commercing with the skies,Thy rapt soul sitting in thine eyes.
quotes.author: John Milton,  L'Allegro, Il Penseroso, Comus, and Lycidas

quotes.quote: You never know who you're inspiring or uninspiring. People notice more than you think.
quotes.author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

quotes.quote: Isn't it amazing how we always have to put our mark on things? And how, from the natural world, we find evidence over and over again that reminds us, not so much of the birds, but of our own stories and our own kinds of art?
quotes.author: Rosamond Purcell

quotes.quote: The history of science is the saga of nature defying common sense.
quotes.author: Kedar Joshi

quotes.quote: Accept the universeAs the gods gave it to you.If the gods wanted to give you something elseThey'd have done it.If there are other matters and other worldsThere are.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Collected Poems of Alberto Caeiro

quotes.quote: Night always turns to day again as long as the sun shall rise, so shall it be for darkened dreams grown pale from compromise
quotes.author: Tracy L. Conway,  I Wandered from New Orleans: Poems from the South

quotes.quote: I am sure now that life is not what it is purported to be and that nature, in the canny words of the Scotch theologue, 'is not as natural as it looks.
quotes.author: Loren Eiseley,  The Immense Journey: An Imaginative Naturalist Explores the Mysteries of Man and Nature

quotes.quote: Death is not in the nature of things; it is the nature of things. But what dies is the form. The matter is immortal.
quotes.author: John Fowles

quotes.quote: Visible objects therefore do not perish utterly, since nature repairs one thing from another and allows nothing to be born without the aid of another's death.
quotes.author: Titus Lucretius Carus

quotes.quote: Fairies with gossamer wings, Bring forth beauty, grace and joyful things. Fairies of the earth are caretakers of our soil, water and trees,They watch over beautiful creatures such as bears, bunnies and bees.Fairies ask that you breathe in and appreciate the vantage point from which you stand,Then trod carefully and respectfully with each intentional step you make across this beautiful land.
quotes.author: Molly Friedenfeld

quotes.quote: Even so, I'm somebody.I'm the Discoverer of Nature.I'm the Argonaut of true sensations.I bring a new Universe to the UniverseBecause I bring the Universe to itself.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Keeper of Sheep

quotes.quote: The Creator has - I say it in all reverence - drawn a myriad red herrings across the track, but the true scientist refuses to be baffled by superficial appearances in detecting the secrets of Nature. The vulgar herd catches at the gross apparent fact, but the man of insight knows what lies on the surfaces does lie.
quotes.author: Israel Zangwill,  The Big Bow Mystery

quotes.quote: I consider a dream like I consider a shadow,' answered Caeiro, with his usual divine, unexpected promptitude. 'A shadow is real, but it's less real than a rock. A dream is real -- if it weren't, it wouldn't be a dream -- but less real than a thing. That's what being real is like.

quotes.quote: It's an already inside outside,The philosophers say it's the soulBut it's not the soul: it's the animal or the man itselfIn its way of existing.

quotes.quote: Y por que el sol es tan mal amigodel caminante en el desierto?Y por que el sol es tan simpaticoen el jardin del hospital?And why is the sun such a bad companionto the traveler in the desert?And why is the sun so congenial in the hospital garden?

quotes.quote: Blue thou art, intensely blue; Flower, whence came thy dazzling hue?
quotes.author: James Montgomery

quotes.quote: Praise be to God I'm not good,And have the natural egotism of flowersAnd rivers following their bedPreoccupied without knowing itOnly with blooming and flowing.This is the only mission in the World,This--to exist clearly,And to know how to do it without thinking about it.)

quotes.quote: Like nature, we must grow with tranquility, beauty, harmony, and love.

quotes.quote: Nature is always talking to you, smiling to you, and singing to you. To understand, you just have to be open to listen with your heart and soul.
